faq.title: Questions
faq.sourcesQ: Where do these jobs come from?
faq.sourcesA: From employers' own hiring systems: {{names}} and {{more}} more, plus USAJOBS for federal roles. We read each employer's board, list what it serves, and take a posting off when a later read finds it gone. Staffing agencies' boards are labelled.
faq.sourcesAPlain: From employers' own hiring systems, plus USAJOBS for federal roles. We read each employer's board, list what it serves, and take a posting off when a later read finds it gone. Staffing agencies' boards are labelled.
faq.applyQ: Do you apply to jobs for me?
faq.applyA: No. You apply on the employer's own site, by hand or with help from Claude, ChatGPT or Claude Code. We never submit an application.
faq.currentA: Each posting shows the employer's posted date when the employer's system states one and keeps it fixed. For boards we read in full, it also shows when we last read the whole board ("feed read"). The largest boards are read in parts over several passes, so their postings show no feed-read time. A role can close between reads; the employer's page is the final word.
faq.fitQ: Will you tell me which jobs I'll get?
faq.fitA: No. Fit compares words: it shows which of a posting's terms your CV uses. It is free, with no account, in the browser where you scanned or dropped your CV. It does not yet read location, work authorisation or seniority, and it never predicts interviews or offers. We are rebuilding CV matching.
faq.resumeA: The text is deleted after {{hours}} hours and the free report after {{days}} days. A paid Full Analysis stays behind its private link for {{paidDays}} days unless you delete it sooner. <trust>Trust</trust> lists every copy.
